title: Smoky Peruvian Egg White Skillet
description: A unique and flavorful Peruvian dish featuring egg whites, smoked paprika, and aji amarillo peppers, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning. This dairy-free friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk the egg whites in a large bowl until stiff peaks form.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped aji amarillo peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour the whisked egg whites over the skillet mixture and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the egg whites are set and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
